column1: # Corrections to src/layout.tsv (the Ghidra export), applied by tools/fwsrc.py.
# Same syntax: C/D/U start end force a range's kind (hex, [start, end)); F addr [name] adds
# a function entry. Keep entries sorted by address, with the reason.
F 0800c1d0                     # crt0 frame_dummy-style init, reached only through a pointer
F 0801eefc                     # vector handlers without a Ghidra function
C 08024066 0802406e            # fault handlers: `b .` loops, vector table targets
F 080262f6                     # through pointers and tail calls only
D 08027cb2 08027d0e            # byte table 00 01 02 ...: Ghidra disassembled it
D 0802825a 080282fc            # byte table 8e 8e 8d ...: Ghidra disassembled it
D 0802a62e 0802a678            # synth parameter table (0x0802A62A): Ghidra disassembled it
